<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex087032026-06-1609-45-17" status="reviewed"><milestone unit="section" n="223.232.211.113.322.122.131.21 zlos sgra ma mthong pas mi zlos pa"/>
         dang po ni rtags rjes su dpag bya la yod pa tshul dang po zhes bya ba'i tshul dang po'i mtshan nyid ston pa'i tshig la lta ba'i dus na mthun phyogs nyid la yod ces bya ba rjes 'gro'i mtshan nyid ston pa'i zlos sgra gtan mthong pa med pas ji ltar zlos | 
         <mentioned>gal te de ltar ma mthong yang 'og nas 'byung pa dang zlos so zhe na |</mentioned>
         gong du bshad pa dang 'di zlos so zhes bya ba ni rigs kyi 'og nas 'byung pa dang 'di zlos so zhes bya ba ni <lb n="33a7"/> rnam pa <expan>thams cad</expan> du mi 'thad pa yin no zhes <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3839">rtsang nag</rs></note> gsung ngo || </seg></TEI>
